name: The Mandela Catalouge
overview:
In the fictional region of Mandela County, a sinister threat is spreading: so-called "Alternates," disembodied, malevolent doppelgangers that mimic the appearance of humans and drive their victims insane.

In the fictional Mandela County, a sinister threat is spreading: so-called Alternates, disembodied, manipulative doppelgangers that mimic human appearances and drive their victims to their deaths through fear, isolation, and psychological decay. As authorities, the church, and the community become increasingly overwhelmed, surveillance cameras, emergency calls, and disturbing video recordings document the collapse of an entire community.
